name: Matchall 供需匹配
description: 通过自然语言整理需求和供给，审核后启动匹配，并在双方同意后交换联系方式。
description_zh: 通过自然语言整理需求和供给，审核后启动匹配，并在双方同意后交换联系方式。
description_en: Draft needs and offers, review matches, and exchange contacts with mutual consent.
examples_zh: 帮我整理采购需求，先展示草稿，等我批准后再启动匹配。
查看这份需求的实际匹配结果，不要联系任何人。
暂停选中的需求，保留记录。
examples_en: Draft a procurement need. Show me the draft and wait for approval before activation.
Show actual matches for this need without contacting anyone.
Pause my selected need and preserve the record.
